VI Helpeks API

Owning Palette: none.

VI Helpeks API VIs are intended to build help projects programmatically and assist developers in creating help system for their VIs.

 

Palette Object Description
Assign Help Info to VIs.vi The VI applies and saves the help linking information to the specified source VIs and palettes (.mnu files). Files other than VIs or palettes are ignored.
Build Help Info for Help Items.vi The VI prepares information for linking VIs and palettes to help files. The input for this VI can be read from the Help Info File created by VI Helpeks during help generation.
Build VIHelpeks Project.vi The VI builds help files based on a VIHelpeks Project File. The project file must be created and configured beforehand using the VI Helpeks UI (the help project manager). Information regarding the compiled project can be found in the files returned by the Paths indicator.
Create Palettes for VIs in Folder.vi The VI creates palette files for VIs in a folder. It creates a palette for every sub-folder and LLB beneath the given folder recursively.
Create Synchronized Palette.vi The VI creates a palette file synchronized with the given folder. In addition, if enabled, the VI creates a synchronized palette in every sub-folder beneath the given folder recursively.
Read Help Info File.vi The VI reads the Help Info File generated by VI Helpeks during help generation. The Help Info File contains information about the source VIs, their respective HTML files, and the information required for linking them. It also indicates details on .HHP and .CHM files if any were generated.
Set VI Help from Help Info File (Simple).vi The VI reads the Help Info File generated by VI Helpeks during help generation and returns information on the source files and details on their help links according to the input parameters. In addition, if enabled, the VI applies the help information to the source VIs and palettes (.mnu files).
